_meta.purpose: Openables: the minimal Ultima VII container verb. An openable is NOT a new prop — it is a flag on a prop that is already painted, plus contents, plus two lines of prose.
_meta.coordinateSpace: NATIVE plate px, keyed by location id. `anchor` is the painted prop position; `approach` is a walkable ORIGIN point (feet at y+15).
_meta.whyNotInLocationFiles: Same reason as residents.json: the location files are compositor output and hand additions do not survive a plate regeneration.

waterfront.label: Force the ledger drawer

onOpen.notification: The seal is cold in your hand.

waterfront.emptyText: The drawer runs on beeswax and does not squeak, which you noticed at the time and have thought about since.

waterfront.label: Open the bonded chest

onOpen.notification: Duty paid on paper, and thirty cruzados that were not on the paper.

waterfront.emptyText: Sound wood, sound iron, and a smell of pepper that will outlast the chest.

waterfront.label: Try the barred door

onOpen.notification: Sixty bahar on the manifest. You count fifty-four stacks and stop counting.

waterfront.emptyText: The bar goes back across easily. It is a new bar and it has not yet learned to stick.

waterfront.label: Look in the open cask

onOpen.notification: Two cruzados in the sediment. Somebody was hiding them or somebody was drunk.

waterfront.emptyText: Rainwater, a drowned gecko, and the reflection of a man who checks casks.

waterfront.label: Prise open the crate

onOpen.notification: Nutmeg, still in its mace. Somebody will notice the lid.

waterfront.emptyText: The lid sits crooked now. It will sit crooked until it reaches Goa.

rua-direita.label: Open the warehouse strongbox

onOpen.notification: Twelve cruzados, a manifest, and three voyages entered where he told you there was one.

rua-direita.emptyText: He does not lock it. That is either trust or the certainty that nobody would dare, and after this week you are no longer sure which.

rua-direita.label: Open the tally crates

onOpen.notification: Ingot, mark, weight. Ingot, mark, weight. Forty cruzados is beginning to look like a wage rather than a gift.

rua-direita.emptyText: Roped again, exactly as you found them. He will check the knots.

rua-direita.label: Search the handcart

onOpen.notification: A copy of a copy, in a fine upright secretary hand — and the fee column leaning.

rua-direita.emptyText: Straw, a broken seal-wafer, and the smell of somebody else's morning.

rua-direita.label: Open the coop

onOpen.notification: Two eggs, and one hen now loose on Rua Direita.

rua-direita.emptyText: The hen has not forgiven you and neither, apparently, has the street.

a-famosa-gate.label: Open the powder barrels

onOpen.notification: Serpentine powder, badly stored. A sentry is already walking toward you.

a-famosa-gate.emptyText: Somebody has put a new seal on the head since you last looked at it. You are fairly sure that is about you.

a-famosa-gate.label: Open the stall box

onOpen.notification: Five cruzados in small coin, under a folded cloth.

a-famosa-gate.emptyText: String, a comb, a tin cup, and the day's takings gone somewhere sensible.

st-pauls-church.label: Haul up the bucket

onOpen.notification: Somebody's rosary, down there long enough to have gone green.

st-pauls-church.emptyText: Cold, and further down than the hill suggests. The rope is longer than the church is tall.

kampung.label: Unroll the mats

onOpen.notification: Tongkat ali, kacip fatimah, misai kucing — bundled, labelled in a hand you cannot read.

kampung.emptyText: Rolled and tied the way she ties them, which is not the way you tied them.

kampung.label: Open the coop

onOpen.notification: Three eggs, still warm. In the kampung this is not theft unless you take all of them.

kampung.emptyText: Empty this morning, and the hens have an opinion about who is responsible.
